title: flt.c_lowshelf~
description: `flt.c_lowshelf~` calculates biquad coefficients for a low-shelf filter that boosts or cuts gain below a specified frequency. Set the cutoff frequency from 20 to 20,000 Hz and the gain from -15 to +15 dB; its five outlets provide b0, b1, b2, a1, and a2 for use with `flt.biquad~`.
